title: Desktop main + packaging: external links, updater, deb/mac makers, package identity
acceptance: main.ts: every BrowserWindow webContents gets setWindowOpenHandler that calls shell.openExternal(url) only for http/https URLs and returns {action: 'deny'}; will-navigate to a non-app URL is prevented and opened externally the same way; the APP_OPEN_EXTERNAL handler (about line 311) only opens http/https URLs.
main.ts: updateElectronApp runs only on win32 (unsigned macOS cannot install Squirrel.Mac updates; Linux is unsupported), with a one-line comment saying why.

forge.config.ts: MakerDeb options add bin 'Hypergen', description 'The AI video editor built for agents', a one-sentence productDescription, homepage 'https://github.com/buckleson/hypergen'; osxSign is {identity: '-'} (ad-hoc) when SKIP_SIGN is set and {} otherwise; the Squirrel description is 'The AI video editor built for agents'; the DMG comment and background-color match the light dmg-background.png (#f7f9fc).
apps/desktop/package.json gains productName 'Hypergen', description 'The AI video editor built for agents', author 'Buckleson', homepage 'https://github.com/buckleson/hypergen'.
Root package.json: remove the unused dev:web_v1 and build:web_v1 scripts if nothing references them. .gitignore: remove the .vercel entry.
build.yml: drop the unused matrix key 'out'.
scripts/release.mjs: comments say the tag triggers the release job in build.yml (no separate Release workflow).

Tests: forge.config.test.ts covers the deb bin and description, osxSign ad-hoc when SKIP_SIGN, and no protocols. A focused test (electron mocked) proves the window-open handler opens http(s) URLs externally and denies, and never opens other schemes. `npx vitest run` in apps/desktop and `npx tsc --noEmit` pass.
tools: Edit; graphify query or codebase-memory to find window creation in main.ts; vitest

help-view.tsx: each external row is one accessible link (the whole row is clickable; its accessible name is the label) with rel='noopener noreferrer'. persist-route.tsx: no 'checkout' transient param and no '/auth/' route handling. desktop-app.ts: the analytics-only _source parameter and DesktopAppDownloadSource are removed and every caller is updated.
index.html meta, og and twitter description: Hypergen is the AI video editor built for agents. Edit video with Claude Code, Codex and your own words, then finish it by hand.
Each listed dead or old-brand file is deleted only after git grep shows no reference outside tests. apps/web/vercel.json is deleted.

tools: Grep for references before deleting; Edit; vitest

title: Agent docs, tool descriptions, project template and README accuracy
acceptance: docs/INSTRUCTIONS.md, and the fallback text in apps/desktop/src/dapi/docs.ts, add one short paragraph: Hypergen is local-first with no account; generate runs on fal.ai with the user's own key; listen uses the user's own Gemini key; transcribe runs locally with Whisper and needs no key; on MISSING_KEY, tell the user to add the key in Hypergen > Settings > AI providers and do not retry. The docs.ts brand-kit text says: style references, components and compositions to copy.

docs/reference/voices/gemini-3.8-flash-tts.md is deleted (the model is not in the catalog). elevenlabs-v3.md no longer mentions elevenlabs-v4. Every model id used in docs/reference/** exists in MODEL_IDS of packages/dapi/src/models.ts; add a test that asserts this.

The generate tool description (packages/dapi/src/tools/generate.ts), docs/reference/tools/generate.md and docs/reference/models.md say: files are sent inline with the request (at most 10 MB), and Hypergen maps each model's fields to its fal endpoint (fields a model does not use are ignored). The apps/cli/src/index.ts generate --help text drops the clause about an audio field taking a scene.

docs/reference/jsx/media.md says the input file appears as the data URI that was sent. docs/reference/tools/README.md recommends the bundled `hypergen mcp` stdio proxy. context.md: fix the line 3 vs line 34 contradiction (the folder the last project was saved to; null until one has been) and use Ctrl/Cmd+S. open.ts and open.md: load it in the editor (the window stays as it is; use window to show it). skills/watch.md: fix the yt-dlp link label. skills/editor.md and jsx/media.md: the symlink advice gets a Windows note (use mklink, or copy the file). transcribe.ts: document that local Whisper does not set the speaker field, or remove the field if unused.

apps/desktop/src/projects.ts template README: no claim about MCP resources; 'All of them talk to the running app.'; the context row lists the playhead and loaded fonts; the listen row mentions the user's own Gemini key; the transcribe row says local Whisper; add rows and npm scripts for check, export, generate, job and window.
Code comments: mcp-config.ts drops the /hypergen:<prompt> mention; the mcp-proxy.ts launch comment mentions Windows too.

README.md: the macOS install note says System Settings > Privacy & Security > Open Anyway (or run xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine /Applications/Hypergen.app); add a line that automatic updates are Windows-only for now; keep the credits line exactly as it is; no dapi or diffusion text.
Tests: npm test passes for packages/dapi, apps/desktop and apps/web, including the existing docs and branding guard tests.
